ToRunNodeTestFile: to run JavaScript node test files

ActionSignatures.ToRunNodeTestFile: ToRunNodeTestFile.Execute(testFilePath: String, workingDirectory: String, timeoutSeconds: Int32) : String

ActionDescriptions.ToRunNodeTestFile:
to run JavaScript node test files
Run an existing JavaScript file with node, without a shell. Returns ExitCode, TimedOut, stdout and stderr. timeoutSeconds must be positive. Does not force node --test; the selected file owns its test runner.
